name: WorkOS
description: WorkOS lets agents manage organizations, users, SSO connections, and directories, and review recent sign-in activity in the signed-in WorkOS workspace. The agent acts with the user's own dashboard role and uses the sandbox environment by default.

prompts.text: Which SSO connections are still in draft, and for which organizations?
Which directories have not synced in the last week?
Show suspicious sign-in attempts from the last 24 hours.

apps.name: WorkOS
apps.description: Organization, user, SSO, and directory management, over WorkOS's MCP server with browser sign-in.
